'''Distorted Enlightenment''' is a [[Effects|Status Effect]] inflicted by [[Draconite|Draconites]] (and ''possibly'' [[Kirin]] in the future). Upon being inflicted by it, the target will glow, receive five times the damage from Draconites, and both deal and receive 20% less damage to and from other parasites. Additionally, the screen distortion presented by the command ''/srp_breathe'' is applied.

Distorted Enlightenment can be avoided by parrying projectiles that inflict it with [[Weapons#Sentient Weapons|Sentient Weapons]].

Distorted Enlightenment does not stack.
